svg.aria-label: Combined UML view. On the left, the actor Traveler is associated with ten use cases in one column: Set Preferences, Submit Requirement, Generate Itinerary, Edit Itinerary (Timeline / Map), Manage Budget, Arrange Transportation, Arrange Accommodation, View Weather-based Clothing Recommendation, View Food and Cuisine Recommendation, and View Itinerary Output. Generate Itinerary includes Set Preferences and Submit Requirement; Edit Itinerary extends Generate Itinerary and includes Manage Budget. On the right, the architecture as six packages: apps/web, @trip/orchestrator, @trip/agents, @trip/tools, @trip/services, and @trip/shared. apps/web delegates to @trip/orchestrator, which dispatches to @trip/agents and uses @trip/services; @trip/agents uses @trip/tools and @trip/services; @trip/tools adapters call the external Maps and Routes API, the Hotel and Flight Search, and the Weather API; @trip/services keeps state in a Redis REST store when configured; every package depends on @trip/shared. Dashed trace links connect each use case to its realising package.
